Ana CS: Quick note — just wrapped a session with Sable Finance onboarding team. They surfaced a few recurring product asks that are blocking completion for multiple seats: 1) an in-console 'Getting Started' checklist that auto-tracks completed steps per-user; 2) a per-role guided walkthrough (Admin vs Analyst) during first 7 days; 3) ability to export onboarding status per-account as CSV for renewal playbooks. They called the export "must-have" for QBRs. :eyes:
Priya CS Ops: Thanks — can you paste any example lines they want in the CSV? I'll add to the capture doc.
Ana CS: Sure — they want columns like `account_id, seat_count, completed_steps, last_active, assigned_csm`. Example: `acct_823,42,7,2024-11-18,ana.cs@redwood.com`
Mike PM: This is helpful. Do they consider the guided walkthrough higher priority than the export? Which one blocks go-live for any customers?
Ana CS: Guided walkthrough is higher for Sable (they have many non-technical analysts). Export is P2 but used heavily for renewals. Walkthrough is blocking one of their pilots.
Jordan Eng: For the guided walkthrough, quick question — do they expect step-level UI hooks (modals/tooltips) or a side-panel checklist? Implementation cost differs a lot.
Ana CS: They said they prefer a side-panel that persists, with optional modals for complex steps. Also requested ability to link to company-specific docs in each step.
Trent PM Research: Suggest we capture this as FR-382 in product board, tag `onboarding`, `exports`, `role-guides`. I'll mark initial priority as P1 (guided) / P2 (export) and request a short impact estimate. @Mike PM can you confirm?
Mike PM: Confirmed. I'll draft a short PRD. @Jordan Eng please give rough engineering hours for side-panel + CSV export (ballpark) by EOD Tue.
Jordan Eng: Ballpark: side-panel walkthrough ~2-3 sprints (1 full front-end + some backend hooks), CSV export ~1 sprint including auth checks. Could push export earlier as quick win.
feedback-bot: tag=feature_request id=fr-382 source=cs-channel
Priya CS Ops: I'll book a 30-min sync with the Sable onboarding lead next week to validate the mockups. Meantime, added their quotes to the capture doc: "If we can't export onboarding status, we'll lose our QBR data" — they said that twice.
Mike PM: Solid. Adding to roadmap intake. @Ana CS can you upload any screenshots they shared to the thread or attach to the doc?
Ana CS: Uploaded in the doc (link copied into the capture doc). Also they gave one more small ask: ability to bulk-mark steps completed for users imported via SSO.
Trent PM Research: Noted. This feels like a 3-feature bundle: walkthrough, CSV export, bulk-mark. We'll treat bulk-mark as P2. I'll schedule triage with Eng + CS to scope and timeline. :calendar:
Priya CS Ops: tagging renewals team FYI — Sable pilot renewal in 10 weeks. If walkthrough shipped before renewal it increases conversion likelihood.
Mike PM: Thanks everyone. I'll create FR-382 and link this thread. Ana/Priya — please keep the thread updated with customer responses. :thumbsup:
